description: Use this when the user asks whether a US ETF is covered, wants to find a fund by name or ticker, or asks how many ETFs the data covers and how recent it is. Returns the date of the data and the count of covered funds by source: the issuers' own holdings files, SEC Form N-PORT filings, trusts' filings, sponsors' files and prospectuses, and how many of the US-listed ETFs that is. With query, it returns up to 50 matching funds with their names, sources and categories; without query, it also lists every covered ticker by source unless include_tickers is false, a long answer. Mutual funds, closed-end funds and funds listed outside the US are not covered. Not for a fund's holdings or figures (get_etf_holdings).

include_tickers.description: Whether an answer without query lists every covered ticker, by source, and only those of source when it is given. true or left out adds the lists, a long answer; false returns the counts and dates alone.

query.description: A ticker or words from a fund's name, for example VOO or semiconductor. Case does not matter.

source.description: Only the funds read from the issuers' own files, only the stock ETFs from SEC filings, only the fixed income funds, only the multi-asset funds, only the derivative-based funds, only the trusts and pools, only the funds from their sponsors' files, or only the funds with only a prospectus file.

name: list_etfs
title: Coverage and fund search
